verdict.rationale: Docs say Better Auth has built-in support for multiple social providers, including Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord "and more". The SSO plugin adds generic OIDC/OAuth2 providers and SAML 2.0. Community users confirm OAuth login via Google, Apple and GitHub, and one reports getting many sign-in options from included plugins and defaults without writing special code. Missing for 10: a documented configuration snippet for social providers, the full list of supported providers to substantiate "broad", and independent hands-on detail on configuring a generic OAuth provider.
